lessons.title: Put resampling inside cross-validation preprocessing
lessons.statement: When class-imbalanced tabular classification uses SMOTE, proposed reuse: Proposed conditional application: Use an imblearn pipeline for SMOTE and scaling within cross-validation. Proposed check: Inspect fold boundaries and log indices so scaling and resampling fit only training folds; score untouched validation rows against no-SMOTE baseline. Limitation: README documentation establishes a described implementation, not verified execution or production readiness.
